name: Leon M.
headline:
Embedded Engineer with a focus on Rust and end-to-end product development. 
Highly skilled in Rapid Prototyping, PCB Design, Rust, C, Python and AI on the edge. Hardware Tinkerer by heart.
summary:
I’m a highly innovative embedded engineer with a passion for building products end-to-end. With schematic and PCB design, CAD work, rapid prototyping with 3D printing, and firmware development in C and Rust, I have experience in every aspect of embedded product development.
My expertise in connectivity protocols such as BLE, MQTT, CoAP, OpenThread, Zigbee, LoRa, WiFi and Matter enables me to create robust, self-healing and highly connected IoT solutions. 
I have successfully led the development through multiple generations of IoT devices, with over 4,000 devices successfully deployed throughout Europe.  
Additionally, I have strong skills in data analysis with Python, and have developed and deployed machine learning models with PyTorch, TensorFlow (Lite), and DeepStream running on the edge.
I am an active contributor to the open source community (especially Rust) and always eager to share my knowledge with others.

positions.title: Embedded and Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed IoT solutions for digitalizing self-storage parks with access control, monitoring, and alerting systems with data analytics
• Successfully led the development of multiple IoT device generations, with over 4000 devices deployed throughout Europe
• Responsible for research and development of new IoT products (PoCs, MVPs) and rapid prototyping with 3D-printing
• End-to-end product design and development: PCB and schematic design, CAD, firmware, connectivity, PCBA and mass production
• Firmware, I2C/SPI driver and algorithm development with Rust, C, Embassy, Zephyr, FreeRTOS, Nordic nRF, ESP-IDF
• Integration of sensors and supporting algorithms, including optical smoke detection and presence detection using mmWave radar
• Hardware and firmware debugging with logic analyzer and oscilloscope
• Tooling for mass production and manufacturing automation (Bash, Python, Linux, Docker)
• Deployment of large-scale self-healing networks with OpenThread, WiFi, MQTT and CoAP
• Local and secure communication via BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy)
• Deployment of deep neural networks on the edge (NVidia Jetson) for on-premise AI-based video analysis (PyTorch, Tensorflow, DeepStream)
• Increasing in-park security with sensor fusion and data analysis

company.name: NOWATCH
company.tagline: The world's first Awareable™️, designed for nervous system regulation.
company.description:
NOWATCH is an Amsterdam-based health-tech company, established in 2020. Our mission is to empower people to feel better. We create technology rooted in science that aims to support healthy habits and a better quality of life. Research-grade sensors and unrivalled personalisation make our product a powerhouse tool for supporting preventative mental and physical health. We fuse science and technology with timeless design into one elegant healthtracker for building stress resilience. When you feel better, the impact extends beyond just yourself – your wellbeing affects the people you love - today, tomorrow, and beyond.

If you are passionate about helping people feel better, we want to hear from you.
